claim_text: Loss of neurofibromin expression in NF1-associated tumors leads to hyperactivation of RAS, because neurofibromin contains a GAP-related domain that accelerates conversion of active GTP-bound RAS to inactive GDP-bound RAS.
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Nat Rev Dis Primers 2017; not in PMC). Statement made by the Gutmann 2017 Primer citing ref 23 DeClue 1991 PMID 1946460; ref 24 Basu 1992 PMID 1570015. Secondary citation: not independent of the cited primary work; primary paper should be read for strength grading.Overlaps with the Xu 1990 claims already in the pending queue (GAP-related domain/RAS-GAP activity); Otto/Rey may merge as supporting evidence rather than count as independent.
independence_flags: secondary citation via review PMID 28230061 of ref 23, ref 24
